files.description: Project overview and current technical direction for the Laravel rebuild. Reviews should keep public OSS language.
Repository-level development guidelines. Defines Laravel Boost conventions, Action pattern expectations, testing rules, and frontend/backend architectural constraints.
Varlock environment contract for Laravel, Infisical, SQLite, Typesense, public Vite flags, and security-sensitive production defaults. Review carefully for fail-closed production behavior.
FrankenPHP PHP 8.5 runtime image with Composer, Bun, SQLite extensions, Varlock entrypoint, and Laravel bootstrap dependencies.
Idempotent container startup script. Creates the configured SQLite path when missing, runs pending migrations, and starts FrankenPHP. Must never reset or destroy persisted data.
Local development stack for the FrankenPHP app and Typesense. Includes persistent volumes, Typesense healthcheck, and container-first runtime wiring.
Minimal FrankenPHP/Caddy configuration copied from the known-working starter precedent. Keep simple until worker mode or advanced serving behavior is justified.
Laravel/PHP dependency manifest and Composer scripts. Dev scripts must respect FrankenPHP and Varlock rather than starting a separate PHP server.
Frontend/tooling dependency manifest. Contains Vite Plus, React/Inertia/Tailwind, Wayfinder, Varlock, and environment validation scripts.
Vite Plus configuration for Laravel, Inertia React, Tailwind CSS v4, Wayfinder, and Docker-compatible HMR on port 5173.
Laravel database configuration. SQLite is the source of truth; DB_DATABASE should point to a persistent volume path in container/Railway environments.
Laravel Fortify authentication configuration. Public registration policy, 2FA, and auth flow changes should be reviewed for security impact.
Primary Laravel web routes for Inertia pages. Controllers should stay thin and avoid embedding business logic.
Business logic Action classes. Mutating domain Actions should own transactions and explicitly call audit logging when domain data changes.
HTTP layer. Controllers should be thin; validation/authorization belongs in Form Requests, Policies, or Gates.
Eloquent models for users and future Vetpedia domain entities. Watch for unsafe mass assignment, missing casts, and relationship/query performance issues.
Laravel service providers. Global bindings, auth hooks, Fortify customization, and boot-time behavior should be explicit and minimal.
Laravel schema migrations. SQLite compatibility, reversibility, auditability, and production-safe migration behavior are critical.
Database seeders for initial users, roles, and future catalogs. Seeders must be idempotent and must not leak real secrets.
Inertia React application bootstrap. Review provider setup, global client behavior, and frontend security assumptions.
Inertia page components. Use Wayfinder-generated routes/actions instead of hardcoded backend URLs.
Reusable React UI components. Preserve accessibility, keyboard support, and safe rendering of user-provided content.
Generated Wayfinder action bindings. This directory is generated and should not be manually edited.
Generated Wayfinder route bindings. This directory is generated and should not be manually edited.
